source_gap_claims.behavior: The authoring standard must explicitly define one primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, input/output, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this complete standard-section inventory; per-entry declarations do not establish the standard's own required sections.
source_gap_claims.subject: Authoring standard content

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject a governed fixture when a required declared section or its referenced section is missing, and diagnostics must identify the rule and relative location rather than accepting headings alone.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers missing standard-section declarations or referenced sections, nor the required rule-and-relative-location diagnostic duty.
source_gap_claims.subject: Governed fixture section validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: The versioned quality-contract schema must accept a valid contract and explicitly record capabilities.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require validation or explicit capability recording for the quality-contract schema.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality-contract schema

source_gap_claims.behavior: The quality-contract schema or validator must reject unsupported versions, malformed types, undeclared fields in the owned quality namespace, unresolved references, and capability or schema-version typos without silently treating them as empty or disabled capabilities.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers these quality-contract schema rejection rules or the prohibition on silently disabling misspelled capabilities.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality-contract schema validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must validate frontmatter, require nonempty name and description, enforce a canonical package name, and verify consistency with the declared Skill identity.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers frontmatter, package naming, or Skill-identity consistency validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Skill frontmatter and identity

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject missing or malformed frontmatter, duplicate keys, conflicting names, and unsupported frontmatter extensions.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these frontmatter negative cases to fail validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter rejection rules

source_gap_claims.behavior: Frontmatter parsing must be safe and must never execute YAML or object constructors.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no parser-safety duty prohibiting executable YAML or object-constructor behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter parser safety

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must enforce fewer than 500 logical lines in SKILL.md, counting frontmatter, blank lines, and code blocks, with 499 passing and 500 or 501 failing.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines or checks the SKILL.md logical-line limit or its boundary cases.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md logical-line limit

source_gap_claims.behavior: Logical-line counting must be identical for LF and CRLF files, and a final newline must not add an extra logical line.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers newline normalization or final-newline counting semantics for SKILL.md.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md line-count normalization

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must recommend a smaller SKILL.md main file without introducing a second hard size gate.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation states this recommendation or prohibits an additional hard size gate.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md size guidance
